title: acceptance.json — Acceptance Criteria Document
description: Schema for acceptance.json, consumed by tdd.sh to track TDD task progress.

project.description: Project identifier in snake_case, matching the consuming repo's name.

description.description: Free-text summary of the project purpose.

tasks.description: Ordered list of TDD tasks. The TDD orchestrator processes tasks whose `gold` field is `current`.

description.description: Detailed description of the task's scope and intent.

acceptance_criteria.description: Concrete, testable conditions that define when the task is complete.

evaluation_command.description: Deterministic command used to evaluate the acceptance criteria of the current gold task. Typically a `docker exec` invocation that runs a specific test file.

gold.description: Task state machine: `current` (in progress), `done` (completed), `backlog` (not yet started).

passes.description: Updated on each acceptance run: `true` if acceptance criteria are met, `false` otherwise.
